request.description: This endpoint can be used to check whether a domain exists for SSL certificate purposes. It's compatible with the Caddy on_demand TLS as described here: https://caddyserver.com/docs/json/apps/tls/automation/on_demand/ask/. It will respond with a 200 status code if it exists or a 404 if it doesn't exist.
